items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training
Min 2 years At least two years of progressively responsible experience performing a range of administrative functions including calendaring, travel, and meeting arrangements.

This position provides analytical and administrative support to the Associate Vice President and Systemwide Controller and the UC Controller department. The administrative officer supports the entire UC Controller office and is responsible for a full range of administrative duties, including travel coordination, providing basic financial support to the unit, and scheduling and meeting coordination.

40% Executive and Administrative Support: Provide administrative oversight and support to the UC Controller Office, including managing the ordering of all supplies, filing, and ensuring the office is kept organized. Serve as liaison to other UCOP and campus units regarding business and general office management issues. Perform short and long-term planning for office operations, demonstrating good judgement in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Coordinate logistics and calendaring for meetings, including booking conference rooms, coordinating catering, initiating service agreements, managing audiovisual and technical needs, and preparing and distributing background materials. Determine need for general office equipment and supplies. Prepare correspondence and other written materials for department management, as needed. Organize, prepare, manage, and maintain unit files and records. Ensure all files and records are maintained accurately and are updated in a timely manner. Maintain lists of records for the unit. Manage the administrative tasks related to onboarding and offboarding employees. Participates in the development and revision of standard operating procedures and guidelines. Other ad hoc projects as assigned.

40% Finance and Accounting: Gather and analyze financial and other resource date; prepare reports or analyses of operational activities, evaluation of current and proposed services, etc. Serve as a resource on researching complex financial discrepancies, escalated customer problems and vendor concerns. Assist with day-to-day office operations. Research and resolve accounting errors and disputes with external vendors, OP accounting staff, and other units as necessary. Submit change or work order requests. Handle purchasing and payments, reconcile accounts, and resolve accounts payable issues. Gather information for quarterly budget projections. Handle a variety of administrative and accounting issues as needed. Ensure compliance with all policies and standards. Perform other duties as assigned.

10% Travel Coordination: Provide support to UC Controller office for all travel coordination and reimbursement. Arrange travel for department management and staff, including researching flights and hotel information, planning logistics, arranging for ground transportation, and making last-minute changes when necessary. Prepare and maintain travel vouchers and all reimbursement forms (including entertainment) for the UC Controller team. Process reimbursements. Exercise independent judgement in assessing and ensuring that all relevant UC policies and procedures are followed.

10% Back-Up Support: Serve as primary back-up to the Executive Assistant to the Associate Vice President and Systemwide Controller in their absence, providing primary administrative support and managing the Controller's and chief of staff's schedule and calendar. Represent Executive Assistant at meetings as needed.
Ability to use sound judgment in responding to issues and concerns.
Solid communication and interpersonal skills to communicate effectively with all levels of staff verbally and in writing.
Solid organizational skills and ability to multi-task with demanding timeframes.
Working knowledge of common organization-specific and other computer application programs.
Ability to use discretion and maintain confidentiality.
